nodes.summary: Data-processing inequality for entropy under a two-point mixture: for nonnegative `g₀, g₁`, `p Φ(𝔼 g₁) + (1-p) Φ(𝔼 g₀) - Φ(p 𝔼 g₁ + (1-p) 𝔼 g₀) ≤ 𝔼[p Φ(g₁) + (1-p) Φ(g₀) - Φ(p g₁ + (1-p) g₀)]`.
nodes.title: Data-processing inequality for entropy under a two-point mixture

nodes.summary: The conditional entropy of `g` in coordinate `e` given the other coordinates, under the Bernoulli(`p`) weight: `p Φ(g(ω^{e↦1})) + (1-p) Φ(g(ω^{e↦0})) - Φ(𝔼[g | ω_{≠e}])`, with `Φ(x) = x log x`.
nodes.title: Conditional entropy in one coordinate

nodes.summary: The entropy `Ent_ν(g) = 𝔼_ν[g log g] - 𝔼_ν[g] log 𝔼_ν[g]` of `g` under the product weight `ν`.
nodes.title: Entropy of a function under a product weight
$x \log x$ is the negation of Mathlib's $-x \log x$

nodes.summary: The function `x ↦ x log x` (with `0 log 0 = 0`). It equals `-Real.negMulLog x` (`esd_Phi_eq_neg_negMulLog`).
nodes.title: Function $x \log x$ with $0 \log 0 = 0$

nodes.summary: Every coordinate weight of `ν` is strictly positive.
nodes.title: Strictly positive coordinate weights

nodes.summary: Sub-additivity (tensorization) of entropy for the Bernoulli(`p`) product measure on `{0, 1}^n` (see S. Boucheron, G. Lugosi, P. Massart, *Concentration Inequalities*, 2013, Theorem 4.10): for nonnegative `g`, `Ent(g) ≤ ∑ₑ 𝔼[Entₑ(g)]`.
nodes.title: Sub-additivity (tensorization) of entropy
